web_reflections.implication: Node child process boundaries support status-only orchestration and captured stdout/stderr summaries.
Generated receipts should use deterministic JSON and compact MD outputs.
Python helper lanes should expose explicit arguments and parseable receipts.
Closeout gates should distinguish staged, unstaged, deleted, and untracked files without trimming status columns.
Whitespace and diff hygiene belong before every sanitized push.
Future CI proposals should stay queued unless they are local/status-only.
Remote branch mutation needs verified local/remote head equality after push.
Windows entrypoints need explicit arguments and no string-built destructive operations.
PowerShell posture remains a local toolchain concern, not a public proof claim.
Codex workflow receipts should keep API-key creation and deployment gates open.
OpenAI API keys and account mutation stay exact-approval gated.
Risk framing belongs in governance artifacts without claiming consciousness or legal closure.
Privacy and security scans should remain explicit closeout gates.
Freed ID reflections can cite DID structure without claiming deployed identity infrastructure.
CBR/Freed ID proposals should separate candidate design from production credentials.
Security tasks should remain validation-first and non-destructive by default.
Governance cleanup can classify maturity gaps without broad deletion.
Runner improvements should prefer secure defaults and bounded disclosure.
Browser and API route notes should avoid raw route publication.
Frontend or Browser-adjacent tasks should preserve privacy boundaries.
GMUT remains aspirational research and empirical closure stays open.
Physics literature reflections should stay source-backed and non-final.
Cosmology and astrophysics references should remain research inputs, not proof closure.
Research refreshers can be queued behind rate-limit and source-quality checks.
Bibliographic refreshers should favor stable metadata and source labels.
